root.label: DOJ files lawsuit against Maryland over federal agent mask bans

events.label: DOJ files lawsuit against Maryland over federal agent mask bans

slots.name: states sued
slots.sentence: Several other states have also passed such laws in response to the Trump administration's immigration crackdown, attracting federal lawsuits. Maryland is now the eighth state the Justice Department has sued over what it describes as attempts to regulate federal agents.

slots.name: filing date
slots.sentence: The federal lawyers filed the lawsuit Thursday against Maryland, its attorney general, the Maryland Police Training and Standards Commission and Prince George's and Montgomery counties.
